# Rocq Prover

> Rocq is a general-purpose interactive theorem prover based on dependent type theory, offering formal verification, proof development, and program extraction capabilities.

Rocq (formerly Coq) is a mature proof assistant with a rich ecosystem including the Rocq Platform distribution, standard library, community packages via opam, and comprehensive learning resources. The project is governed by the Rocq Consortium and supported by an active global community.

## Key Topics

- Rocq Prover
- Rocq Platform
- Dependent Types
- Formal Verification
- Theorem Proving
